subtitle: Karachi's largest public beach, watched over by the hilltop shrine of an 8th-century Sufi saint the city still credits with turning away cyclones.
spike_statement: Locals credit the 8th-century Sufi shrine on the bluff with steering cyclones away from Karachi; militants bombed it in 2010, killing at least seven.

levers.photo_tone: Arabian Sea haze over grey-brown urban sand, camel and horse silhouettes against a smog-softened sunset, the shrine's blue dome lit gold on the bluff above the crowd
